lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 7 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are positioned posterior to the pectoral fin. Each column contains 3 to 5 discernible local maxima arranged in a grid-like configuration.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to create a coordinate-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low intensity on the ventral edge.
